context_requirements: Expression of gastric H+/K+-ATPase (ATP4A/ATP4B), which is essentially restricted to gastric parietal cells and not expected in these nine non-gastric cell lines
An acidic extracellular microenvironment or dependence on proton extrusion for survival, which is not a defined feature of these lines under standard culture
For the reported anti-inflammatory effects, a Th2/eosinophil-driven tissue context that is absent in these cell lines
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark transcripts at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines at 10 micromolar that is not explained by vehicle or general toxicity
Evidence of ATP4A or ATP4B expression and functional dependence in these lines

evidence.supports: Pantoprazole can induce apoptosis in gastric cancer cells, but this is a gastric-lineage context and not expected in the nine non-gastric lines
PPI therapy reverses an esophageal Th2/allergic transcriptional signature in PPI-REE, a tissue context absent from these cell lines
PPI treatment downregulates eotaxin-3 and Th2 cytokines in esophageal biopsies, again a tissue-specific rather than cell-autonomous effect
PPI-responsive esophageal eosinophilia is an immune-mediated esophageal entity, not a general transcriptional response of cultured cell lines
Omeprazole altered peripheral blood mononuclear cell gene expression in vivo, but effects were modest and not reproduced in the present cell-line panel
